about: Spoken-register guidance and example exchanges for voice agents, per call language and business type. AI-drafted on 10 Oct 2026 (founder decision 3, docs/evidence/first-call-review-2026-10-10.md). EVERY entry is review: needs_native_review until a native speaker has read it; set review to native_reviewed with the reviewer's name in reviewed_by when that happens. Openings are a starter's greeting in that language. The register line and the word swaps (the formal or written form on the left, what people actually say on the right) go into every agent's prompt in that language (calevate_shared.spoken_style.register_guidance); the example exchanges seed new scripts (starters, the script assistant) and stay editable by the client. Example lines show HOW to speak, never facts: they name no price, time, address or stock level, so an agent cannot repeat a made-up fact from them.

te-IN.register: Everyday spoken Telugu as people talk on the phone, neutral and understood in both Telangana and Andhra, in Telugu script, with the English words people use (order, price, delivery, call back). Polite with అండి and గారు, never stiff.

_default: హలో, మీ దగ్గర ఇది దొరుకుతుందా అండి?
సరే అండి, no problem. మీకు వీలైనప్పుడు call చేయండి.
retail: మీ దగ్గర ఎండు మిర్చి ఉందా అండి?
Delivery గురించి నా దగ్గర details లేవండి. మీ area ఏదో చెప్తారా?
clinic: తప్పకుండా అండి. ఏ problem తో రావాలనుకుంటున్నారు?
అర్థమైంది అండి. మీకు ఏ రోజు, ఏ time వీలవుతుంది?
real_estate: మీ project లో 2 BHK flats ఉన్నాయా?
మంచిది అండి. Site visit కి ఏ రోజు రాగలరు?
insurance: మీ policy details నా దగ్గర లేవండి. మీరు ఏ policy తీసుకున్నారో చెప్తారా?
సరే అండి. మీ పేరు, policy number చెప్తే note చేసుకుంటాను.
education: Spoken English course కి admission ఉందా?
సరే అండి. ముందు ఒక demo class చూస్తారా?
local_services: రేపు ఏ time మీకు వీలవుతుంది అండి?
automobile: Bike service కి ఇవ్వాలి, ఎప్పుడు రావొచ్చు?

openings.inbound: నమస్కారం అండి, {business} కి call చేసినందుకు thanks. చెప్పండి, ఏం కావాలి?
openings.outbound: నమస్కారం అండి, {business} నుంచి call చేస్తున్నాను. ఇప్పుడు రెండు నిమిషాలు మాట్లాడొచ్చా?

hi-IN.register: Everyday spoken Hindi in Devanagari, with the English words people use (order, price, delivery, call back). Polite with जी and आप; prefer 'we' forms (बताते हैं) so no gender is assumed.

_default: हैलो, आपके पास ये मिलेगा क्या?
एक minute जी, देख कर बताते हैं।
हाँ जी, है। आपको कितना चाहिए?
बाद में बताता हूँ, अभी थोड़ा busy हूँ।
ठीक है जी, कोई बात नहीं। जब time हो तब call कीजिए।
retail: आपके पास लाल मिर्च है क्या?
एक minute जी, देख कर बताते हैं।
हाँ जी, है। कितनी quantity चाहिए आपको?
एक किलो। Home delivery होती है?
Delivery की details अभी हमारे पास नहीं हैं जी। आपका area कौन सा है?
clinic: Doctor साहब को दिखाना है, appointment मिलेगा?
ज़रूर जी। किस problem के लिए आना है?
समझ गए जी। आपको कौन सा दिन और time ठीक रहेगा?
real_estate: आपके project में 2 BHK flat हैं?
एक minute जी, देख कर बताते हैं।
हाँ जी, हैं। आपका budget कितना है?
बिल्कुल जी। Site visit के लिए कौन सा दिन ठीक रहेगा?
insurance: मेरी policy का renewal कब है?
आपकी policy की details हमारे पास नहीं हैं जी। कौन सी policy है आपकी?
ठीक है जी। अपना नाम और policy number बता दीजिए, हम note कर लेते हैं।
education: Spoken English course में admission चल रहा है?
हाँ जी। Student कौन सी class में है?
ठीक है जी। पहले एक demo class देखना चाहेंगे?
local_services: कल haircut के लिए slot मिलेगा?
एक minute जी, देख कर बताते हैं।
कल आपको कौन सा time ठीक रहेगा?
ठीक है जी, आपका नाम बता दीजिए।
automobile: Bike की service करवानी है, कब ला सकता हूँ?
आपकी bike कौन सा model है जी?
ठीक है जी। कौन से दिन ला सकते हैं?

openings.inbound: नमस्ते जी, {business} में call करने के लिए thank you. बताइए, क्या चाहिए?
openings.outbound: नमस्ते जी, {business} की तरफ़ से call है। अभी दो minute बात हो सकती है?

en-IN.register: Simple, warm Indian English as people speak on the phone. Sir or madam once, not every line. Mix in Hindi or Telugu words if the caller does.

_default: Hi, do you have this in stock?
Yes, we have it. How much would you need?
I'll tell you later, I'm a bit busy now.
No problem at all. Call us whenever it suits you.
retail: Do you have dry red chilli?
Yes, we do. How much do you need?
I don't have the delivery details with me. Which area are you in?
clinic: I want to see the doctor. Can I get an appointment?
Sure. What would you like to see the doctor for?
I've had a fever for two days.
Understood. Which day and time suits you?
real_estate: Do you have 2 BHK flats in the project?
Yes, we do. What budget are you looking at?
I'd like to see the site first.
Of course. Which day can you come for a site visit?
insurance: When is my policy due for renewal?
I don't have your policy details with me. Which policy is it?
Okay. Tell me your name and policy number and I'll note it down.
education: Are admissions open for the spoken English course?
Yes, they are. Which class is the student in?
Okay. Would you like to attend a demo class first?
local_services: Is there a slot for a haircut tomorrow?
Okay. May I have your name?
automobile: I need my bike serviced. When can I bring it?
Okay. Which day can you bring it in?
